name: adcopilot-microsoft-ads
description: Microsoft Ads (Bing Ads) help in your AI client, through AdCopilot. Today it checks your Microsoft Advertising UET tag in Google Tag Manager, reports Bing traffic and conversions in Google Analytics (GA4) by source, medium and campaign, finds UTM and auto-tagging gaps, guides conversion goal setup, prepares a Google Ads import from your Google Ads account, drafts responsive search ad copy and does the budget pacing math. Direct access to your Microsoft Advertising account comes when Microsoft approves AdCopilot's API access; there is no date yet. Every change is proposed first and made only on your yes. Made by Atromx Intelligence, not by Microsoft.
